Lara M: quick thread  need a brokerage/selection play for when multiple SIs express interest in the same HW+marketplace bundle. deterministic rules vs auction? need a decision by Mon.
Ben T: deterministic for speed but with a fairness layer. proposed priority: 1) AE CRM owner (named acct) 2) SI with existing active relationship tag 3) response_time (fastest to accept) 4) partner_capacity tag.
Sophie R: agree. add a right-of-first-refusal window: if an SI is already 'engaged' in CRM, give them 48h to accept. if no engaged SI, open a 24h broker window.
Ken Y: curious about a simple scoring approach to avoid hard rules. e.g. score = (relationship_score * 3) + (response_score * 2) + (capacity_score * 1). highest score wins; tie -> round-robin broker assignment. keeps it auditable.
ops-bot: Broker claim created: "NimbusTech" -> brokerage_queue. claim_id=CLM-9009 :robot_face:
Lara M: can someone draft the scoring pseudo and the SLA/escalation bullets? i'll turn into a one-pager.
Ben T: here's a compact pseudo to start:
```yaml
# brokerage scoring prototype
weights:
  relationship: 3   # existing contract/active engagement
  response: 2       # time to accept / email reply speed
  capacity: 1       # partner_capacity tag (high/med/low)
thresholds:
  r_ofr_window_hours: 48
  auction_window_hours: 24
selection:
  compute score per interested_SI:
    score = relationship*weights.relationship + response*weights.response + capacity*weights.capacity
  if any SI.engaged and within r_ofr_window -> assign to that SI
  elif auction_window open -> assign to highest score after auction
  elif tie -> assign to next broker in rotation
```
Sophie R: SLA notes: 48h acceptance SLA for SI right-of-first-refusal, 24h for auction responses, 72h for HW validation (if on-prem/demo required). after SLA elapses -> escalate to partner-leads + AE.
Ken Y: also enforce overlap suppression: if AE or SE contacted primary contact within last 14 days, AE gets priority and system should annotate claim with "recent-contact". prevents duplicate outreach.
marketplace-bot: Notification: broker flow published to #partnerships. sample claim: "NimbusTech" -> CLM-9009. pinged @ops-team. :zap:
Lara M: great — i'll draft the one-pager with these bullets + a short example timeline and sample email templates. want to pilot with 3 accounts next week.
Ben T: +1 to pilot. will add a small FAQ for multi-SI edge cases (conflicts, pricing differentials, exclusivity asks).
Sophie R: i'll prep the partner notification templates and ops checklist for the pilot.
Lara M: thanks team — this should make decisioning much faster and reduce churn.
